keyLimits.en: 2.9% + 30¢ per successful domestic card transaction, no setup or monthly fee. International cards add 1.5%, currency conversion adds 1%, manually entered cards add 0.5%. Usage-based, no fixed plan price.

cautions.en: No flat subscription fee; cost scales with transaction volume and card type (domestic vs international, manual entry, currency conversion each add a surcharge on top of the base rate).
Custom/enterprise pricing available for high-volume merchants, negotiated directly and not published.

capabilities.en: Payment processing across 195 countries and 135+ currencies, with access to 100+ payment methods.
Built-in fraud prevention via Radar Lite and PCI compliance included at no extra cost.
99.999% average historical uptime and 24/7 customer support.

limitations.en: No flat monthly plan for standard payments; every transaction incurs a fee, which can be costly at scale compared to negotiated enterprise rates.
International and manually entered cards, plus currency conversion, each add extra surcharges on top of the base processing rate.

reason.en: Widely used competing payment processor with comparable per-transaction pricing.
Payment processing competitor, particularly strong in emerging markets.
Alternative payments infrastructure focused on bank-to-bank and recurring payments.

unknowns: No explicit maximum transaction volume cap stated; enterprise/custom pricing exists but exact thresholds and negotiated rates are not public.
